content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim remains at CO-16 after the specific requested information was provided twice, so repeating that action is unlikely to resolve the payer's unmet-document issue. A human specialist is needed to identify why the submitted document is not satisfying the request and coordinate correction within timely filing."}
